# <span id="aanchor260"></span> Stored Reports

For archival purposes, FLOWCAL can store reports that have previously been generated. This is useful for keeping a record of reports associated with a monthly close. The stored report includes data about who created the stored report, the date and time, the associated close group and measurement month, comments, and one or more files.

Files of any type can be stored with a report; however, because the files are stored in the database, users need to be cautious of file size.

Stored reports may be edited or deleted until the associated close group and month is closed. After the close, the reports are locked for audit purposes.

A close group is not required, but without it, editing or deleting a stored report will not be restricted by the close process.

<div class="procedure">

To create a stored report:

1.  Go to **Reports** \> **Stored Reports** from the main menu or from the Standard Reports menu.
2.  Go to **Store** \> **New**.
3.  Enter a name for the stored report and assign a close group.
4.  Select a month and year with which the stored report is associated.
5.  Go to **File** \> **Add** to add files to the stored report.
6.  Enter additional comments as needed.
7.  Click **Store**.



<img src="data:image/png;base64," class="ScreenShot" style="width: 461;height: 367;" />

Export all of the stored report files to a local or network directory by going to **File** \> **Export All** while in view mode.

</div>
